root_cause: evidence-generation script bug, not a scientific-computation issue: in run_v10a_execute.py build_evidence, the delta expression was "(entry.get('validation') or {}).get('conservative_threshold') is not None and float(...) - float(entry['gate']['gate'])". When conservative_threshold is None the is-not-None guard short-circuits to False, so the whole `and` expression evaluates to boolean False instead of None. Location: workspace/v10a_execute/217aa87779de4953a5aeeed24f407b1e/run_v10a_execute.py, build_evidence gate_decision per_search_gates delta entry.
semantic_note: S4 has no conservative threshold (no eligible tier-1 converged candidate at the gate p), hence no delta is computable; the correct value is null, never the boolean false.

scope_impact.s4_verdict: FAIL unchanged (verdict derives from the reason 'no eligible (tier-1 converged) candidate at the gate p', not from delta)
scope_impact.other_evidence_files: evidence/v10_gate_decision.json (line 55) and evidence/v10a_execute_results.json (line 40) already record S4 delta as null

disposition: Evidence is immutable per V10-S08: evidence/v10a_gate_decision.json is NOT overwritten or re-generated. This file is the sole correction record. Readers must interpret per_search_gates[3].delta = false as null (delta undefined) when using v10a_gate_decision.json.

No other logic changed.
